description: Save a download of a builder app's backend as a file on this computer and return its path and size (the file is never put into the chat). what: code = the backend as a NestJS + Prisma + Postgres project ZIP with OpenAPI, a Postman collection and a deploy guide (every plan with an account); data = all tables of the live backend as a ZIP of JSON or CSV files (format), app users included, so it holds personal data: say so; backup = one backup by its id from builder_backend_status (.jsonl.gz). path = where to save it (default this folder with the file name AppForShare gives); an existing file is never replaced. Read only on AppForShare.

backup.description: Backup id from builder_backend_status, with what: backup

name: export_builder_backend
title: Download the backend code or data
